question.text: Books of accounts and records must be preserved by PMs for:

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI requires portfolio managers to preserve their books of account and other records for the preceding five accounting years. The Trap: Shorter or longer periods misstate the rule - the regulatory floor is five preceding accounting years. Note: Source: NISM-Series-XXI-A PMS Distributors workbook (Sep 2025), page 99.
